banner.cuerpo: Everything below this point is a mock-up of the analytics dashboard committed for Stage V (January 2027). The charts use fixed demonstration data.
banner.aviso: None of these figures reflect the institution's real activity. Do not use them to make decisions or to report to third parties.

preview.descripcion: Its purpose is to agree now on how each chart looks and reads. In Stage V these same charts are wired to the institution's real data.
preview.cierre: All four charts are fed by a demonstration-data constant included in this view's source code; there is no platform query behind them.

matriculas.pie: Sample data: new enrollments per month across a reference academic year.
matriculas.aria: Area chart with sample data: {{total}} new enrollments spread over twelve months, peaking in {{mes}} with {{pico}} enrollments.

embudo.pie: Sample data: the path from prospect to enrolled student in a reference admissions cycle.
embudo.aria: Admissions funnel with sample data: out of {{entrada}} prospects, {{salida}} enroll, which is {{tasa}} percent.

programas.pie: Sample data: average classroom progress among the students enrolled in each program.
programas.aria: Bar chart with sample data: average classroom progress across {{programas}} programs, highest in {{mejor}} at {{avance}} percent.

actividad.pie: Sample data: sessions started and submissions recorded on each day of a reference week.
actividad.aria: Stacked bars with sample data: {{sesiones}} sessions and {{entregas}} submissions spread over one week.

reports.descripcion: Inventories and listings of what the platform currently holds, with filters, sorting and CSV export. The last tab is a preview of the analytics dashboard planned for Stage V and contains no data from this institution.

estado.sinPermiso: Your role is not allowed to read this report, so the block is empty. The other reports on this screen are unaffected.
estado.errorCarga: This report could not be loaded. No estimate is shown in its place.
estado.soloLectura: You are viewing this section read-only: you can browse and export every report, but not the actions that write to the platform, such as resyncing the Moodle classrooms.

tabla.vacio: This report has no rows yet. They will appear here as soon as the first record is created.
tabla.sinCoincidencias: No row matches the current search and filters.

tabla.notaExportacion: The exported CSV contains exactly the visible rows, with the filters and sorting you have applied, and includes a UTF-8 byte order mark so Excel preserves accented characters.

programas.descripcion: Catalogue of registered programs — the unit being offered and the one students enroll in — with their level, required credits and owning department. Real data read from the platform.

cursos.titulo: Moodle classrooms, their program and their sync status
cursos.descripcion: Classrooms registered on the platform, each with the program it belongs to and the date it was last synced. What is offered and enrolled in is the program; the classroom is the LMS piece that lives inside one. Real data read from the platform.
cursos.syncError: The Moodle classroom inventory could not be synced.

notaProgramaNoDisponible.permiso: The Program column could not be filled in because your role has no access to the academic programs section; what appears there does not mean these classrooms belong to no program.
notaProgramaNoDisponible.error: The Program column could not be filled in because the program composition could not be read; what appears there does not mean these classrooms belong to no program.

usuarios.descripcion: Roll of users with their status, roles, how many Moodle classrooms they are enrolled in and whether they have a mirrored Moodle account. Real data read from the platform.

panel.descripcion: Access audit for the admin panel: who has an account, with which role, and when they last signed in. Real data read from the platform.
panel.sinCatalogoRoles: The role filter is empty because the role catalogue could not be read. The table and the export still work using the role name carried by each account.

webinars.descripcion: Registered webinars with their video source, start date and whether they are published and visible on the landing page. Real data read from the platform.

podcasts.descripcion: Registered episodes with their publication date and the order in which they are shown. Real data read from the platform.

rutas.descripcion: Routes the server currently has registered, with their method and scope. Useful for the technical delivery record. Real data read from the platform.
rutas.nota: The server declares {{total}} registered routes. Scope is derived from the route prefix, the same criterion the server uses to require panel credentials.

banner.cuerpo: The analytics reports (historical conversion rates, trends and cohort retention) belong to Stage V of the contract, planned for January 2027. The endpoints and the history needed to compute them do not exist yet.
banner.aviso: Every figure on this tab is invented and exists only to show the shape these reports will take. They do NOT describe this institution and must not be used for any decision or report.

previa.sinExportar: This block deliberately offers no export: a downloaded file loses the "sample data" label and would end up circulating as if the figures were real.
previa.cierre: Once Stage V enters development, these three blocks connect to the analytics endpoints and move into the real-reports half, export included.

conversion.descripcion: Admissions funnel from prospect to enrolled, term by term. Requires the admissions history that arrives in Stage V.

tendencia.descripcion: New enrolments month by month across a full academic year. Requires the historical enrolment series that arrives in Stage V.
tendencia.pie: Monthly series of new enrolments. Sample figures, not this institution's.
tendencia.aria: Sample chart with {{total}} new enrolments over the year and a peak of {{pico}} in {{mes}}.

retencion.descripcion: Share of each cohort still active at 3, 6 and 12 months. Requires at least a year of activity history, which arrives in Stage V.
